title: Purair® ADVANCED Ductless Fume Cupboards
meta_title: Purair Advanced Ductless Fume Hoods - High-Efficiency Fume Containment
meta_description: The Purair Advanced Series ductless fume cupboards are designed to protect users and the environment from hazardous vapors with innovative filtration technology.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, ductless fume cupboard, fume containment, hazardous vapor control, laboratory safety equipment
short_description: The Purair Advanced Series ductless fume cupboards are available in 7 standard sizes in metal or polypropylene construction. This Series of high-efficiency products is designed to protect the user and the environment from hazardous vapors generated on the work surface.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair Advanced creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Compounding \ Balance Enclosures, Microscopes and Robotic Equipment \ Forensics \ Histology \ Educational \ Microscopy \ Mobile and Classroom Demonstrations \ Pharmaceutical \ Powder Fingerprinting \ Powder Weighing \ Sample Prep Work \ Soldering \ Solvent Cleaning and Welding \ Veterinary \ Dental
seo_content: High operator protection to fume and particle hazards. Improved clamping eliminates bypass leakage. Filter blockage alarm. Polypropylene work surface (stainless steel option). High capacity filters for more demanding applications.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
